title: Patient positioning and respiratory gating in Diagnostic Radiology PANDORA
summary: All CT examinations will be performed using a dual-source CT scanner with identical data acquisition parameters in both cohorts. A ceiling-mounted, camera-based laser tracking system is used to record the movement of the patient surface. The system has an integrated CT interface and can be supplemented with room loudspeakers and video glasses for audiovisual patient coaching to carry out breathing commands. In addition to respiratory gating, the laser tracking system also serves as a positioning aid to enable optimized positioning of the patient. In the field of radiation therapy, the surface scanning system has been used in clinical routine for years to scan the patient surface as part of 4D CT imaging.
conditions: Other specified symptoms and signs involving the circulatory and respiratory systems
